research_topic: What is quantum uncertainty and why is it important?
key_conclusion: Quantum uncertainty is a fundamental constraint on incompatible-observable statistics, whereas instrument error, decoherence, and readout noise are distinct and calibratable contributors to observed qubit records. The selected proposal tests whether a four-part calibrated uncertainty budget predicts a qubit information task better than an aggregate-noise model.
